export.decisions: XFID user decisions D2 (small components) and D3 (r=8), 2026-10-04
export.self_intersection_tolerance_note: contact tolerance as a fraction of the mesh extent; P20 uses 1e-10, whose absolute value reports a phantom contact on needle triangles (tests/test_geometry_gates_v2.py); 1e-12 and 1e-14 gave the same verdict on the saved v17 baseline r=8 surface

labels.widths_and_gap: lattice representability limit (research), not a physical or manufacturing minimum

near_zero_gradient_band.bound: zero-set shift per unit dphi along the crossing edge is at most 2 dphi (0.625 mm for a 0.3125 mm step)
near_zero_gradient_band.text: at every interior sign-change node (exact zero = fluid) the largest crossing slope |phi(n)-phi(m)|/h over 6-neighbours m of the opposite sign is >= threshold; array-boundary sign-change nodes are unmeasured; central-difference counts (zero_level_gradient_floor) are reported, not gated

non_blind: v16 values and v17 values in SRCMAP-03a/LOWDIM records and read-only plan-review measurements are known; thresholds are not tuned after the canonical run
non_blind_v2: crossing-slope failing/interior sign-change nodes measured before registration (plan Amendment 1, E1): baseline 567/9,390, LOWDIM-03 parent 7/8,062, LOWDIM-04B 0.3125 mm trial 0/8,038; the rule was chosen after the #29 diagnostic (non-blind). A future normal-velocity backend must re-register the central rule as hard

predecessor_profile.difference: profile_id, near_zero_gradient_band, predecessor_profile, non_blind_v2; all other fields identical
